## New work

Prepared by **icekylinx with GPT-6 Astra assistance**. The new contribution is
the post-center timing and ordered composition of dirty gauges with rank-four
response kernels, including the 14 disjoint M-helper groups, explicit scalar
word, frame and cleanup treatment, independent local argument, physical global
integration, paid accounting, and combined conditional κ assembly.

The same helper can first serve its own gauge and then donate to a larger

This ordering, its actual frame nesting, and its global use are the substantive
delta. Earlier gauge/kernel primitives and the SAME504 scalar construction
retain their original authorship.
